settings_inline_inspectThemeTokensHint: Preview live Nocturne tokens and surface values.

settings_inline_exportHint: Choose a unified backup or keep one subsystem isolated when that is safer.

settings_inline_includeNovelsHint: Exports repository-aware novel state without bundling plugin binaries.

settings_inline_appMetadataExportHint: Exports portable profile metadata only. Machine-local settings are intentionally excluded.

settings_inline_storageWaitConfirmation: Storage, and wait for confirmation there.

settings_inline_needsReviewHint: Only these ambiguous leftovers need your approval. Choose a candidate or explicitly skip the remap.
settings_inline_skipRemapHint: Keep this orphan source untouched in the reconciled restore payload.
settings_inline_unresolvedHint: These sources still could not be reconciled automatically. Restore can continue, but their original backup source IDs will stay untouched.
settings_inline_extensionMatchesHint: Aethon found matching extensions for leftovers that still depend on source installs.
settings_inline_noConfidentMatches: No confident installable matches were found for the remaining leftovers.
settings_inline_trackerOauthWindowHint: Aethon opens a tracker login window and captures the OAuth callback automatically. If your system blocks it, paste the redirected callback URL below.
settings_inline_hardcoverAuthIntro: Hardcover currently authenticates third-party apps with an API key. Aethon stores it only in this local profile and uses it for novels/books.
settings_inline_currentProfileRestoreHin: This advanced path restores directly into {profile} instead of the recommended sandbox target.
settings_inline_restoreHandoffTargetHint: The selected backup will be handed off to the inactive local profile and confirmed there before restore starts.
settings_inline_mangaRestoreCurrentProfi: Runs the proven manga restore path in the current profile after the current confirmation gate is satisfied.
settings_inline_noSourceReconciliationNe: No source reconciliation work was needed.
settings_inline_sourceReconciliationSumm: Aethon parsed this backup locally, resolved exact matches first, and then ran bounded source inference on the leftovers.

settings_inline_ecoHint: Lowest CPU/network use. Updates finish more slowly.

settings_inline_balancedHint: Recommended balance between update speed and system load.
